snippet.title: PRAGMATA - Main Trailer
snippet.description:
PRAGMATA lands April 17! 
Check out the main trailer, showcasing previously unseen areas and the enemies you will face in the 3D printed lunar research station. Now available one full week earlier.

Play the demo:
https://www.capcom-games.com/pragmata/en-us/demo/

Pre-order today:
https://www.capcom-games.com/pragmata

About Pragmata
Capcom’s newest IP—PRAGMATA. An all-new Science Fiction action adventure with its own unique hacking twist! 
It is the near future, and protagonists Hugh and his android companion Diana, must work together as they make their way through the cold lunar research station.

PRAGMATA launches on on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2 on April 17, 2026. 

Official X: https://x.com/PRAGMATAgame/

#PRAGMATA

Discord: https://discord.gg/Capcom
